verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent, columns, and semantic search generate AI-driven insights, summaries, and suggestions from papers/data (docs-11, docs-12, docs-18, docs-20, docs-1), and one HN user praised getting a concept list with citations quickly (comm-1). However, multiple hands-on community reports document concrete failures: incorrect summaries misrepresenting confirmed hypotheses, hallucinated facts even when quoting directly, and worse performance than a competing tool (comm-3, comm-4, comm-5, comm-7), and Elicit's own docs admit ~90% accuracy requiring verification (comm-2). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking showing consistent accuracy, and resolution of documented hallucination complaints.
